tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Page background — the default ground for every page and most sections.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Form fields, menus, modals and article cards that sit on ivory.

tokens.name: sage-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted bands (introduction, philosophy) between ivory sections. Never behind photography.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section rules, card dividers, footer columns. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Form-field and outline-button borders — holds 3:1 on ivory and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on ivory, surface-raised and sage-wash (13.6:1 light, 14.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, helper text and secondary copy on ivory, surface-raised and sage-wash (≥5.9:1 light, ≥6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary button fill, active nav state, links and pull-quote marks; as text on ivory, surface-raised and sage-wash (≥8.1:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forest fill (the primary button label). Dark in the dark theme because forest lightens there.

tokens.name: forest-ground
tokens.usage: Deep editorial bands: Leadership & Coaching pillar, closing invitation, footer. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: charcoal-ground
tokens.usage: Speaking & Interpretation pillar, video section and the gallery lightbox. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: slate-ground
tokens.usage: Speak French Fast band and Language Education pillar — the one cooler hue, reserved for the language pathway.

tokens.name: on-ground
tokens.usage: Text on forest-ground, charcoal-ground and slate-ground (≥7.8:1 on all three, both themes).

tokens.name: champagne
tokens.usage: Accent on dark grounds only: eyebrows, hairline rules, numerals and the focus ring on forest-, charcoal- and slate-ground (≥5:1). Fails on ivory (1.5:1) — never use it there.

tokens.name: champagne-ink
tokens.usage: Champagne as text on light grounds — eyebrows and small labels on ivory (5.2:1 light; 10.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Decorative fields: image mats, placeholder frames, the BGYCC band. Text on it is on-sage.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text on a sage fill (7:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Speak French Fast accent as text and links on ivory and surface-raised (7.8:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form validation messages and invalid field borders, always with a written message. On ivory and surface-raised.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on ivory, surface-raised and sage-wash: 2px solid, 3px offset. On dark grounds use champagne.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the mobile menu, lightbox and video modal.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline only, once per site. Fluid: clamp(44px, 7.2vw, 88px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Inner-page heroes and the closing invitation. Fluid: clamp(40px, 5.4vw, 64px).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Pillar titles and article headlines. Fluid: clamp(28px, 3vw, 36px).

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Lead with purpose. Influence with clarity.
styles.usage: Philosophy statements and pull quotes. Only verified quotes from Kaycee.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Equipping people to think clearly, communicate across boundaries and lead with purpose.
styles.usage: First paragraph under a hero or section title. Max 34em.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Coaching that begins with self-awareness and ends in responsibility.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Sessions available in English and French — to be confirmed.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, helper text, footer copy.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set in uppercase. Section labels and the three-line professional title. champagne-ink on light, champagne on dark.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Article and video metadata, captions, image-credit and placeholder labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title, meta rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field label to input; button icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; card inner padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; paragraph rhythm; grid gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on desktop; title to lede.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Block separation within a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop — the default breathing room.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero top padding and the quiet gap before the closing invitation.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photography, pillar bands, sections — the system is square by default.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, form fields, article and video cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Category chips and the play button only.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Outer content width on wide displays.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: Max line length for body copy.

tokens.name: measure-lede
tokens.usage: Max width for ledes and hero intros.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Navigation bar height before scroll.

tokens.name: nav-height-scrolled
tokens.usage: Navigation height once scrolled past 24px.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Elevation is used only where something floats above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Scrolled navigation bar, dropdown menus, the video modal.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour shifts, underline draws, focus states.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menu, accordion and dropdown open/close; card hover lift.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Section reveals, headline line reveals, image mask wipes.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between staggered items (headline lines, cards).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every entrance and reveal — fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Menu and accordion open/close; the nav height change.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover and colour transitions.
